name: experiment
words: how an agent's cut goes through the Experiment — the room, the two arms, the reviewers' signed verdicts, the proposal, the stamped promotion, and the ladder a promoted agent climbs down (rest · decommission · restore)
text: THE EXPERIMENT AND THE CUT (Phase 8 sp4, canon 0010 §5). An AGENT's template never cuts straight onto the shelf: saying “cut the bob draft” on an agent template OPENS THE EXPERIMENT, held at the interlock (L2) in plain words. Before the hold the kernel checks the evidence: the agent's GOLDEN SET must stand on the shelf (bob.golden — every engineered agent is born with one; draft it and cut it first) and the graph its template names must stand there too. On your yes an EXPERIMENT ROOM opens on a floor of the path (room exp-bob-1 on floor ops — the floor where bob stands, else the first floor open; nothing promotes out of an experiment room except through this gate) and the experiment runs on the kernel's beat: the CANDIDATE (the draft's declaration) is instantiated as a TRIAL LIFE of bob's own self in the room — it joins there, runs the golden set through its own graph, records the run under the kernel's run id and stops whole; the CURRENT (the standing version, when one stands) runs the same cases over the rail; a first version has one arm, said honestly. Then the kernel asks the GRADER and the CRITIC under the experiment's marker (the hull's event edge): each reads the kernel's record of the arms — never its own words — answers in a fixed form (the grader: current: <A–F>, candidate: <A–F>, verdict: candidate | current | neither; the critic: what changed and risk: low | medium | high) and writes a SIGNED VERDICT under its own name; SECURITY and IDENTITY are honest empty slots on the card until spoonful 6; resiliency is whether any watch turned red while the arms ran. THE VERDICT IS A PROPOSAL: it reaches your chat as THE EXPERIMENT card with the arms, every reviewer by name, where the evidence leans (promote · hold · unsure) and two words you may say. “promote bob” (or “promote bob to floor ops” / “promote bob to room x on floor ops” — where the next life stands is a field of the promotion; unsaid, it stands where bob stands now, else at the universe) holds THE STAMPED PROMOTION (L2 for an agent; a resident's asks the code): on your yes the candidate lands on the shelf as the next version (a sibling), the draft is spent, bob's SEAT is written and the kernel seats bob's next life from the shelf — the wear table follows that join; the room's record is the replay. “decline the bob experiment” is routine and recorded; the draft stays under your seat to fix and cut again. THE LADDER (rule 11): “rest bob” (L2) stops bob's life at a safe boundary, its self kept; “decommission bob” (L3, your code; a rested body only) is the grave — its lease, bench, gateway key and mind assignment removed, its schedules, watches and intentions rested, its wear links closed; its DID, its joins and its record STAY; “restore bob” (L2) is a NEW life from the shelf's standing version, never a revival (refused while its template is retired — restore the template first). THE PRUNE BEAT retires, hourly and never at request time, the crafts nobody wears any more (every body that ever wore one decommissioned); a craft another living body wears is kept, the spine's own always. “show the experiments” lists them; “show the seats” shows every promoted agent, where it stands and its rung.
